ios.desc:
Macro Meals is the smarter way to track your nutrition. Whether you're bulking, cutting, or maintaining, Macro Meals helps you stay on track by calculating your daily macronutrient goals and connecting you with real-world meals that fit your diet.
Unlike traditional calorie trackers, Macro Meals makes healthy eating feel effortless. No more guessing or stressing over what to eat: just simple, intuitive tools and AI-powered suggestions to help you plan, log, and crush your goals.
With Macro Meals, you can:
Calculate your macros based on your personal data and fitness goals
Log meals manually or by scanning barcodes
Discover local dishes that match your nutrition plan
Track your progress with a clean visual dashboard
Get smart meal suggestions powered by AI

*FOOD SCANNING & MEAL FINDER RESULTS REQUIRE A SUBSCRIPTION.

TERMS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

android.desc:
MacroMeals is your AI-powered meal tracker built for real life. Whether you’re eating at home, ordering in, or grabbing takeout, MacroMeals helps you stay on track with your macro goals without the stress.

Key Features:

Macro Calculator – Instantly generate daily targets based on your age, weight, goals, and activity level.

Meal Logging – Enter meals manually, scan barcodes, or snap a photo (AI camera coming soon).

Smart Suggestions – Get personalised meal ideas aligned with your remaining macros.

Live Macro Dashboard – Visualise protein, carbs, fats and calories in real time.

Location-Based Finder – Discover macro-friendly meals near you.

Perfect for fitness enthusiasts, busy professionals, and anyone tracking keto, high-protein, vegan or custom diets.


1. Built to simplify tracking.
2. Designed to help you stay consistent.
3. Powered by AI to support your goals.

quotes.text:
It’s a calorie and macro tracker, yes. but not the kind that makes you feel bad about eating a sandwich or forgets you're a human being.

iOS:

I built it because I’ve tried most of the popular trackers, and while they’re powerful, they tend to be clunky, overcomplicated, or oddly guilt-inducing. Macro Meals is my attempt to build something simple, helpful, and user-friendly for regular people who just want to eat better and not obsess over it.

Some features:

Photo-based meal logging (uses image recognition to estimate macros)

Macro-aware meal suggestions from restaurants near you

Daily macro feedback that adjusts based on what you’ve already eaten

Give it a try, would love to hear some feedback!

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.macromeals.app
iOS:
